text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d g-p-s s-p-o-o-f-e-r s-a-t-e-l-l-i-t-e m-i-m-i-c-r-y h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e n-e-a-r t-h-e c-o-u-r-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a d-e-t-e-c-t-a-b-l-e r-f e-m-i-s-s-i-o-n s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a d-e-p-l-o-y-m-e-n-t a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e y a-c-t-o-r i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e g-n-s-s c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e b-e-a-c-o-n s a t t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o d-e-v-i-a-t-e d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a n-o-t-a-b-l-e s-i-g-n-a-l a-n-o-m-a-l-y l-o-g, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a r-e-a-l-t-i-m-e s-p-e-c-t-r-u-m m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-r-o-g-r-a-m-m-e-d t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e t-o m-a-t-c-h a m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e b-l-o-b-b-i-n-g f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-h-e s-p-e-c-i-f-i-c a-t-t-e-n-u-a-t-i-o-n d-i-s-t-i-n-c-t-i-o-n, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-b-s-e-r-v-e-d t-w-o d-r-o-n-e s d-i-v-e-r-t-i-n-g f-r-o-m t-h-e-i-r r-o-u-t-e-s, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g t-h-e d-e-v-i-a-t-i-o-n v-i-a d-r-o-n-e t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y c-a-p-t-u-r-e, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a p-r-o-p-e-r i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t t-o t-h-e o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n-a-l t-e-a-m.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-o-v-e-r-e-d o-n-e i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e a-t t-h-e d-e-s-i-g-n-a-t-e-d l-a-n-d-i-n-g s-i-t-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t s a n-d h-a-n-d-l-e r m-a-r-k-s, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a c-h-a-i-n-o-f-c-u-s-t-o-d-y r-e-c-o-r-d e-n-t-r-y.
6) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-o-w-e-r-e-d d-o-w-n a-n-d m-o-v-e-d t-h-e e-q-u-i-p-m-e-n-t b-e-f-o-r-e a l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-c-e c-o-u-l-d c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-e-m-p-o-r-a-l y e-t t-r-a-c-e-a-b-l-e g-e-o-l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n p-i-n-g, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
